body: Hi there! Thanks for the report. I've queued this for a reproduction check on Wails v3. We'll keep this open while we investigate.

Hi there! I reproduced this on Windows. A fix is queued. Thanks!

<details>
<summary>Test evidence</summary>

Tested master ([pinned source](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/commit/6b767b48336dc3f0737957d8206958abf5f77492)). Each VM started from its clean test snapshot and ran offline.

Trigger: Focus an attached modal window, then call modal.Close() on Windows and observe whether the owner window becomes the active/focused window.

Expected: After closing the foreground modal, the owner window is active and focused (IsFocused true).

**Windows 11 24H2 ARM64 — reproduced**

```text
go build ./workflow-repro; run reviewed native Wails GUI probe (50-second application deadline)
Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.26100.0
go version go1.27.1 windows/arm64
REPRO_READY: modalFocused=true
REPRO_OBSERVATION: attached ownerFocused=false modalFocused=true
REPRO_OBSERVATION: afterClose ownerFocused=false
REPRO_ASSERTION: expected ownerFocused=true after closing foreground modal, actual ownerFocused=false
```

The failing regression assertion is the evidence; compilation and setup succeeded.

Scope: a running native Wails window against this pinned source, with measured DOM/native observations. This does not establish behavior on other OS releases, Wails versions or untested interactions. Only the trigger and measurements listed above were tested. 

Revision selection: current public master. Results apply only to the pinned source and OS shown; an inferred version is not attributed to the reporter.

Independent evidence review agreed with these results.

</details>
